blocks.text: METZ, France – Pope Leo XIV warned on Monday that relations between nations were becoming increasingly uncivilised with people boasting of “lies and deceit”, urging Europe to help break the cycle and foster respect in international ties. Speaking in the city of Metz near the border with Germany, where he was wrapping up a four-day visit to France, Leo did not mention any world leaders by name. The pope sees Europe as a counterweight to major powers and has in the past called on the European Union to overcome tensions and rediscover unity in pursuit of peace in Ukraine and beyond.
